column1: # What this fixture proves, independently of the reference: '+' rows must be

# local name; '*' matches anything. Perl packages: a method call whose receiver
# typed resolution leaves untyped is marked unresolved_member, in the script and in
# the module, and no call is drawn from the script's top level, where the only call
# that is no builtin names a sub nothing defines.
